Name: Item Bag for Ridgeside Village
Author: HazelMQ
Description:
[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
The Item Bag for Ridgeside Village: cooking, crops, fish, seeds.
There are two version, one is  for only RSV items.
Optional files contains other mod:   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25788]Ridgeside Forage Crops and Bushes[/url]
Please read the file title and download correct file.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Extract the compressed package to the location where the item bag is installed. 
Keep the .json in "......\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\......\Item Bags\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags"
将压缩包解压至item bag安装的文件夹，保证.json文件在item bag的 Modded Bags内。
